items.headline: EIR scoping meeting set for Oakmead Parkway housing project
items.summary: The city, along with the Heritage Preservation Commission and Planning Commission, is holding a public scoping meeting for the environmental review of a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway.

items.headline: Six new homes permitted on Adeline Avenue in Communications Hill
items.summary: Six single-family homes (Phase 3.1 of the Communications Hill development) were permitted at addresses 802-822 Adeline Avenue, with construction values ranging from about $474,000 to $512,000 per unit.

items.headline: 147 homes, commercial building planned for Homestead Road
items.summary: The Planning Commission is set to act on a subdivision map for 147 residential units plus one commercial building at 3521 and 3591 Homestead Road, under state SB 330 rules that limit the city's ability to reduce project size or add new conditions.

items.headline: Council to weigh higher affordable housing fees for developers
items.summary: A special study session is scheduled to consider raising inclusionary housing requirements and updating the below-market-rate in-lieu fees developers pay on new rental and ownership housing projects.
